Untriangulate.js

Hello

It's a tool script to execute 'Untriangulate' for polygon object.

download: http://www.tres-graficos.jp/blog/files/article.php?id=106

caution: this script requires a lot of calculation time, so don't run for big mesh.

DEMO MOVIE: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S2SviX0zaxE

Best
